articles.headline: Greenland Energy Company Announces Extension of Jameson Land Farm-Out Agreement with 80 Mile plc
articles.summary: Greenland Energy announces a variation and novation extending its Jameson Land farm-out arrangements with 80 Mile and March GL. Changes to contractual exploration arrangements are distinct from a new drilling permit, completed drilling or proven reserves.
